checks.title: Concurrency: 2 phien cung sua Basic information dong thoi - co optimistic locking / canh bao xung dot khong
checks.precondition: Mo cung 1 product base tren 2 tab/phien khac nhau (cung role owner do .env chi con 1 account)
steps: Tab A: sua field X, chua bam Save
Tab B: sua field Y (khac field X tren cung product base), bam Save truoc
Tab A: bam Save sau
Quan sat gia tri cuoi cung tren server - field Y cua tab B co bi ghi de mat khong
checks.observation_point: Gia tri cuoi cung cua ca 2 field sau 2 lan Save; co canh bao xung dot nao xuat hien khong
checks.expected_result: CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra
checks.open_question: PUT /api/products/{id} gui FULL-REPLACE 8 field (KB-027), khong thay dau hieu optimistic locking/version check nao trong evidence hien co. Neu 2 phien cung sua dong thoi, phien Save sau co the ghi de (last-write-wins) mat thay doi cua phien truoc do field khong hien thi tren form dang sua nhung van nam trong payload full-replace. Day la rui ro MAT DU LIEU chua duoc kiem chung bang test thuc te - can PO/Dev xac nhan co co che bao ve nao khong truoc khi coi day la production-ready.
